observed_effects: Space assets are no longer just recovery evidence; they become inputs to a program-behavior test.
The no-call chain is correctly demoted/repositioned as substrate for space reading and safety validation.
Model-result intake/reentry dry-run becomes the reusable fixture contract for model-side outputs.
Trace ledger and guard matrix become validator requirements for Scenario 1.
A future internal-function tuning pass can now adjust actual components against this test.
